experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Built an LLM agent (LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Claude Haiku 4.5) for a multi-omics cancer research platform, integrating three tools for gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation, and dataset provenance.
Surveyed and explored 14 heterogeneous source datasets (gene expression, gene properties, nomenclature), owning the identity-spine datasets and setting metadata boundaries for downstream modelling.

Designed a deterministic hallucination-guard architecture and fail-safe data resolution via live Ensembl/HGNC APIs with a local 19,213-gene parquet fallback and circuit breakers, ensuring data quality.

experience.title: Data Consultant (AI Engineering & AI System)
bullets: Proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid-based product start-up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo.

Contributed the MCP implementation to the client's production repository (TypeScript/Node.js MCP server, OpenAI query generation, Convex database), now in live day-to-day use; engagement received a 5-star commendation from senior leadership.
